description: Update a conversation. Two optional fields. status: active, resolved or archived; resolving or archiving hands the thread back to the AI, like the inbox. ai_paused: true takes the thread away from the AI as the account owner (the inbox Claim button, reopens a resolved thread); false hands it back (the inbox Transfer to AI). Resume is refused with 409 when the pause came from a solicitation pause, a fraud flag or a connected-account pause; those are lifted in the portal. status is applied first, then ai_paused.

ai_paused.description: true pauses the AI on this thread as the owner; false hands it back to the AI.

status.description: resolved or archived clears the assignment. pending and escalated are set by the system only.

name: update_conversation
